lessons.title: Lesson 1: Four Seasons & Weather Conditions
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Four Seasons & Weather Conditions.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK Lớp 5.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Subject + will + Verb (bare infinitive). Used to predict future events, especially weather forecasts.
concepts.example: 'What will the weather be like tomorrow?' - 'It will be cold and stormy.'
concepts.essence: Simple future modal verb expressing expectations about tomorrow.

concepts.definition: Add -y to weather nouns: sun -> sunny; rain -> rainy; wind -> windy; cloud -> cloudy; fog -> foggy.
concepts.example: There is a lot of rain today -> Today is a rainy day.
concepts.essence: Notice the double consonant: sun -> sunny; fog -> foggy.

rules.meaning: S + like / love + season + because it is + weather adjective.
rules.example: I like autumn because it is cool and windy.
rules.essence: Always give a sensory reason explaining your weather preference.

workedExamples.prompt: Reorder the words to make a sentence: 'will / in / like / What / Hanoi / be / the / tomorrow / weather / ?'
steps: Bước 2: Trợ động từ tương lai: 'will'.
Bước 3: Cụm chủ ngữ: 'the weather in Hanoi'.
Bước 4: Động từ và từ nối: 'be like tomorrow?'.
Bước 5: Ghép lại: 'What will the weather be like in Hanoi tomorrow?'
workedExamples.answer: What will the weather be like in Hanoi tomorrow?

commonMistakes.mistake: Writing 'It will is cold' instead of 'It will be cold'.
commonMistakes.why: After 'will', the verb must be in base form (bare infinitive): 'be'.
